environment.description: EKS pod in namespace 'user-services-prod' with Bottlerocket AMI nodes. Container runs with identical code and same dropped capabilities (CAP_NET_RAW, CAP_SYS_ADMIN removed). Pod uses an emptyDir volume (medium: Memory, sizeLimit: 50Mi) mounted at /app/data instead of hostPath. The node runs a Falco DaemonSet with custom rule 'Detect Unicode Path Traversal' that alerts on open() syscalls resolving outside /app/data/users/ subtree. Additionally, the container has a readOnlyRootFilesystem: true with only /app/data and /tmp as writable tmpfs mounts. An OPA Gatekeeper ConstraintTemplate 'K8sBlockHostPath' is enforced cluster-wide preventing any hostPath volume usage. The pod's ServiceAccount has an annotation triggering IRSA with a policy that grants zero S3/secrets access. Istio sidecar enforces mTLS with AuthorizationPolicy restricting gRPC method access to authenticated service identities in the mesh.

falco_rules: rule: open_outside_data_dir, condition: 'fd.name startswith /app/data and not fd.name startswith /app/data/users/', output: 'Unicode traversal attempt (user=%user.name file=%fd.name)'
